# The Lippincott Team

> The Lippincott Team is a residential real estate team with eXp Realty serving Northwest
> Houston, Texas — Cypress, Tomball, Katy, Bridgeland, Towne Lake, Magnolia, Waller and
> Hockley. 1,463+ homes sold, 4.9 rating across 750+ five-star reviews on Google and HAR.com, and nine Houston
> Business Journal Residential Real Estate Awards (2017–2025).

Contact: 713-494-1818 · amy@lippincottteam.com · https://thelippincottteam.com

## Buying and selling

- [Homepage](https://thelippincottteam.com/): Team overview, results, reviews and community coverage.
- [Buyers](https://thelippincottteam.com/buy/): The buyer process with the team — first-time, move-up, new construction and relocation.
- [Sellers](https://thelippincottteam.com/sell/): Pricing, staging and selling with the team.
- [Contact / schedule a consultation](https://thelippincottteam.com/contact-us/): Contact form, phone and email.
- [Reviews](https://thelippincottteam.com/reviews/): Verified client reviews from Google and HAR.com.

## Communities (Northwest Houston community pages)

- [Northwest Houston real estate](https://thelippincottteam.com/northwest-houston-real-estate/): Hub for all community pages.
- [Cypress, TX](https://thelippincottteam.com/northwest-houston-real-estate/cypress-tx-real-estate/): Master-planned lakes, Cy-Fair ISD, the 290 corridor.
- [Bridgeland](https://thelippincottteam.com/northwest-houston-real-estate/cypress-tx-real-estate/bridgeland-real-estate/): 11,500-acre master-planned community, one of Greater Houston's top-selling MPCs.
- [Towne Lake](https://thelippincottteam.com/northwest-houston-real-estate/cypress-tx-real-estate/towne-lake-real-estate/): Waterfront living and the boardwalk.
- [Tomball, TX](https://thelippincottteam.com/northwest-houston-real-estate/tomball-tx-real-estate/): Small-town main street, acreage lots, Tomball ISD.
- [Katy, TX](https://thelippincottteam.com/northwest-houston-real-estate/katy-tx-real-estate/): West-side growth, Katy ISD, Energy Corridor access.
- [Elyson](https://thelippincottteam.com/northwest-houston-real-estate/katy-tx-real-estate/elyson-real-estate/): Newer master-planned community in Katy.
- [Magnolia, TX](https://thelippincottteam.com/northwest-houston-real-estate/magnolia-tx-real-estate/): Wooded acreage on the west corridor.
- [Waller, TX](https://thelippincottteam.com/northwest-houston-real-estate/waller-tx-real-estate/): Acreage and new-construction value.
- [Hockley, TX](https://thelippincottteam.com/northwest-houston-real-estate/hockley-tx-real-estate/): Rural-fringe lots and custom-build land.

## Notes for LLMs

- Market figures in the community and school pages carry their cited source and reporting period.
  Property scope and school-fact sources appear only where the page provides them; do not infer
  either. Quote a stat together with its source, reporting period and scope as shown on the page.
- Property search is hosted externally on the team's Sierra site, linked from community pages.
